content: Oil companies should not get to privatize the profits and socialize the damage. Cut carbon emissions, invest in clean energy, and make polluters pay for the transition.
Congress should raise the federal minimum wage and protect collective bargaining. Workers deserve a union and a living wage, not another lecture about waiting for the market.
Health care is a human right, not a perk tied to your employer. Medicare for All would replace a maze of insurance denials with one system accountable to voters.
Congress should protect abortion access nationwide. Reproductive freedom and bodily autonomy should not disappear when someone crosses a state line.
I support universal background checks and Congress should ban assault weapons. Gun safety laws respect responsible owners while making the next school shooting harder.
Congress should create a path to citizenship for DACA recipients and expand legal immigration pathways. Permanent limbo is not a serious policy.
Deterrence only works when adversaries believe America will finish the mission. Pulling back in the middle of a military campaign invites a larger war later.
Parents should choose the school that fits their child, and states should expand school vouchers. District bureaucracies should not trap families by ZIP code.
Cities should fund the police, hire more officers, and impose tougher sentences on repeat violent offenders. Public safety is the first duty of government.
America should drill more oil, approve pipelines, and expand domestic energy production. Affordable energy and national security matter more than activist timetables.
Washington should cut federal spending and lower taxes before asking families for another dollar. The national debt is unsustainable, not an accounting abstraction.
States should restrict abortion and protect unborn life. A humane society can support mothers without pretending life begins only when it is politically convenient.
Government-run health care would replace insurance bureaucracy with federal bureaucracy. Real health care choice requires transparent prices and market competition.
A nationwide $25 minimum wage kills jobs in towns where small businesses cannot absorb city-level labor costs. Washington should stop pretending every local economy is identical.
Congress should secure the border and create a path to citizenship for DACA recipients. Enforcement and a functioning legal pathway belong in the same bill.
Cut carbon emissions, invest in clean energy, and expand domestic energy production while the grid catches up. Climate goals and reliable power both matter.
